title: 2023 POKEMON LATEST EVOLUTION Sticker #077 MEWTWO Kanto Edition
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This 2023 Pokemon Latest Evolution Sticker #077 features the legendary Mewtwo character from the Kanto edition. The card is a standard size and has a multi-color attribute with a regular finish. It belongs to the Pokemon TCG game and is part of the Evolutions set. 

The card is suitable for collectors of all ages, with an age level of 4+. It is a common rarity and has no autograph or vintage features. The manufacturer is Nintendo and the card type is Pokemon. This sticker is perfect for fans of the Pokemon franchise who want to add a unique card to their collection.
